newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Siberian gas line explodes, exports not affected.
newsitem.headline: Siberian gas line explodes, exports not affected.

text.p: A section of natural gas pipeline near Russia's giant Yamburg gas field exploded late on Tuesday, but supplies to Europe and local markets were not affected, the Emergency Situations Ministry said on Wednesday.
A ministry spokesman said a 51 km section of the pipeline near the Arctic Yamburg field was out of service for repairs, but gave no reason for the blast.
Natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom said exports to Europe were not hit and local supplies rerouted through a spur.
"Locals joked that 10 such explosions could not affect exports," Gazprom spokesman Vladimir Zhukov said.
The pipeline section, 110 km north of the town of Nadym in Western Siberia's Tyumen region, exploded on Tuesday at 0250 Moscow time (1050 GMT).
Explosions in Russia's ageing gas and oil pipelines are common.
